trial_court: Court of Civil Judge-01, West, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi (CS SCJ No. 1673/19)
case_name: Manju vs The Oriental Bank Of Commerce

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Manju, wife of Sh. Balram
parties.respondent_defendant: The Oriental Bank Of Commerce through its General Manager

facts_of_case: Plaintiff is the legally wedded wife of Sh. Balram who worked with defendant bank and received pension after his retirement. After his death, plaintiff was not receiving her husband's pension despite best efforts made by her.

legal_principles.principle: A legal notice served on the defendant is a prerequisite for filing a suit.
legal_principles.held: a legal notice dated 06.08.2019 was served upon defendant but of no avail, hence the present suit is filed.

legal_principles.principle: A plaintiff's status as a legally wedded wife is crucial in determining entitlement to family pension.
legal_principles.held: Prayer is made as under - (a) The plaintiff is declared legally wedded wife of Late Sh. Balram, S/o Sh. Bir Bahadur on the basis of marriage solemnized with the plaintiff according to the customs and ceremonies prevalent in the society.

outcome.final_order: The court ordered the defendant to pay the family pension of the plaintiff's husband to her.

use_for_drafting: drafting a suit for declaration and injunction in property disputes
guidelines for drafting a petition for permanent and mandatory injunction
practical use cases for advocates in family law disputes
